experience.company: Enterprise Mobility · Galicia, Asturias and León
bullets: Full ownership of the Galicia region: 70 active accounts per year, 66 of them opened by me, and over 800 units sold, growing steadily.
B2B portfolio segmentation, ranking accounts by purchase history, potential and account type.
Built my own AI tooling (n8n, Claude API) to automate sales analysis and account prioritisation.
Branch at Spain's 5th busiest airport by traffic volume: a team of over 30 and the P&L.
12% increase in ancillary product revenue through purchase-behaviour analysis and team coaching.
Customer satisfaction sustained at 85% of reviews with the top score.

Process redesign down to root cause: the parking handover was being skipped because the tablets had no signal there; I arranged wifi installation with AENA, the airport operator, and retrained the team to restore it.
Grew monthly rental days by 37% in a single year.
Improved ancillary product sales and cost control, making it Spain's No. 1 city branch for the fiscal year.
Hired and trained a Management Trainee who led Spain's city-branch results for several months and was promoted to Manager eight months later.
Operational coordination of the Madrid Airport and Coslada branches, including operations and cost management through the pandemic.
From Feb 2020, day-to-day management of the team and the Madrid Airport branch.
Customer service, contract management and ancillary product sales.
Bookkeeping, invoicing, contracts and supplier relations.

paragraphs: I'm a business profile: over five years running operations, teams and clients in demanding B2B environments. I'm comfortable in sales strategy, marketing and operations management. I understand how a company works from the inside.

What sets me apart is that I can also build with AI. Not as an engineer, but as someone who spots a problem, designs the solution and ships it. I've built real tools that are in production and in active use.
